title: Food checks: local knowledge and a national view
titleZh: 食品监管：地方经验与全国视角
summaryZh: 一份FSA董事会报告比较两种大企业监管方案，讨论数据、地方专业能力与改革成本，保留提议而非已实施的状态。
levelReason: 编辑估计B2：比较两个制度框架，区分机构论证、利益相关方质疑与尚待检验的假设；含让步、条件与复杂名词短语。

sentences.text: Food safety and standards regulation is not only about finding a problem in one shop; it also involves understanding decisions that can affect many branches and suppliers.
sentences.zh: 食品安全与标准监管不只是发现某一家商店的问题，也涉及理解那些可能影响许多分店和供应商的决策。

sentences.text: In a report prepared for its September 2026 Board meeting, the Food Standards Agency examined how national oversight could work alongside local expertise.
sentences.zh: 英国食品标准局在为2026年9月董事会会议准备的一份报告中，探讨了全国层面的监督如何与地方专业能力协同。

sentences.text: The report, written by Emily Antcliffe, sets out proposals for further design rather than presenting a fully implemented replacement for the existing system.
sentences.zh: Emily Antcliffe撰写的这份报告提出的是有待进一步设计的方案，而非已全面实施、替代现有体系的制度。

sentences.text: Its starting point is a tension: local officers understand particular places, while large retailers make decisions whose effects extend well beyond one local authority.
sentences.zh: 其出发点是一种张力：地方工作人员了解具体地区，而大型零售商所作决策的影响远超单一地方政府的辖区。

glosses.zh: 张力；两方面之间的矛盾

sentences.text: Some local authority stakeholders questioned why large businesses were receiving attention when smaller businesses could present greater risks.
sentences.zh: 部分地方政府利益相关方质疑：既然较小企业可能带来更大风险，为何要把注意力放在大企业上？

sentences.text: The Agency’s response was that even where individual branches meet requirements, decisions taken across a large company can influence consumers and supply chains on a much wider scale.
sentences.zh: 该局的回应是，即使个别分店符合要求，大公司整体作出的决策仍可能在更大范围影响消费者和供应链。

sentences.text: It argued that company-wide information could reveal risks that are harder to see when each location is considered separately.
sentences.zh: 它认为，相比逐个地点分别考察，覆盖整个公司的信息可能揭示较难察觉的风险。

sentences.text: This argument supports a proposed national role, but the report also says that the underlying assumption must be tested further during detailed design.
sentences.zh: 这一论点支持拟议的全国层面角色，但报告也表示，在详细设计中必须进一步检验其基本假设。

sentences.text: Six possible frameworks were assessed, with the comparison focusing on their contribution to intended outcomes rather than simply on how easy they would be to introduce.
sentences.zh: 报告评估了六种可能的框架，比较重点是它们对预期目标的贡献，而不只是实施难易程度。

sentences.text: Two frameworks were recommended for further work, both combined with changes intended to strengthen the local system.
sentences.zh: 报告建议进一步研究其中两种框架，两者都结合了旨在加强地方体系的改变。

sentences.text: Under Direct Assurance, large businesses would submit company-wide data and audit evidence to the Agency, which would assess that information centrally.
sentences.zh: 在“直接保证评估”方案下，大企业将向该局提交全公司数据与审计证据，由该局集中评估。

sentences.text: Local authorities would remain the competent authority, using the Agency’s assessment to inform their own regulatory work rather than giving up their responsibilities.
sentences.zh: 地方政府仍是主管机关，利用该局评估指导自身监管工作，而非放弃其职责。

sentences.text: The alternative would make the Agency the direct regulator for large food businesses, responsible for national oversight, official controls, enforcement and intervention.
sentences.zh: 另一方案将使该局成为大食品企业的直接监管者，负责全国层面的监督、官方管控、执法和干预。

sentences.text: Local authorities would continue to regulate other businesses under that model, so a stronger national role would not mean removing local regulation from the system.
sentences.zh: 在该模式下，地方政府仍监管其他企业，因此强化全国角色并不意味着从体系中取消地方监管。

sentences.text: The report presents Direct Assurance as requiring less structural change, while describing the second option as more closely aligned with the programme’s objectives overall.
sentences.zh: 报告认为“直接保证评估”所需结构性变化较少，同时认为第二方案整体上更契合项目目标。

sentences.text: Neither recommendation settles the practical questions of staffing, finance, legal powers or the digital systems needed to make the approach work.
sentences.zh: 两项建议都尚未解决人员、资金、法律权限，以及落实该方式所需数字系统等实际问题。

sentences.text: In particular, the report warns that creating national arrangements must not become a reason to reduce the resources available to local food teams.
sentences.zh: 报告特别警告，设立全国性安排不能成为削减地方食品监管团队可用资源的理由。

sentences.text: Most businesses would still depend on local oversight, and the cost of changing the system must be considered alongside the expected benefits.
sentences.zh: 大多数企业仍将依靠地方监督，而且制度变更成本必须与预期收益一并考量。

sentences.text: The proposals also include better registration, clearer guidance and improved sharing of information, rather than treating the choice of regulator as the whole reform.
sentences.zh: 提议还包括改进登记、更清晰的指导与更好的信息共享，而非把选择监管者视为改革的全部。

sentences.text: Different governments may ultimately choose different approaches, so the Agency intends to balance consistency with local knowledge and devolved responsibilities.
sentences.zh: 不同政府最终可能选择不同方式，因此该局希望在一致性、地方知识与权力下放职责之间取得平衡。

sentences.text: Detailed work with experts and stakeholders is intended to produce an evidenced and costed model before formal consultation.
sentences.zh: 与专家及利益相关方共同开展的详细工作，旨在正式咨询前形成有证据支撑且已核算成本的模式。

sentences.text: For readers, the distinction matters: the report explains why reform is being considered and what must still be examined, not proof that either model has already improved food safety.
sentences.zh: 对读者而言，这一区别很重要：报告说明为何考虑改革、还有哪些问题需要研究，并非证明任一模式已经改善食品安全。

words.zh: 张力；两方面之间的矛盾
words.note: a tension在这里指地方经验与跨地区影响之间需要协调的张力。
could后用动词原形reveal，意为揭示信息中潜藏的风险。
intended outcomes意为预期成效，是评估框架的尺度。
staffing指人员配置，与finance、legal powers并列，是尚待解决的实施问题。
formal consultation指正式征求意见，在本句位于模型形成之后。

sentences.note: 留意本句中的固定搭配，并结合中文对照复述完整意思。

questions.text: How can a national regulator use local knowledge without duplicating local work?
questions.zh: 全国监管机构如何利用地方经验，同时避免重复地方工作？

expressions.note: 可替换后面的内容，讨论类似情境。
